title: Aesthetic Dental Designs, P.A
description: Aesthetic Dental Designs, P.A. (operating commercially as Dental Arts of Atlantis) is a fully licensed and accredited dental healthcare corporation headquartered at 5057 S Congress Ave, Suite 401, Lake Worth Beach, Florida (NPI: 1235501420). The practice is anchored by a distinguished clinical team, featuring Dr. Colleen Lam, D.M.D. and Dr. Serrano. The organization provides comprehensive clinical infrastructure specializing in advanced restorative, cosmetic, and multi-generational family dentistry. Its core competencies include high-precision digital prosthodontics, advanced smile designs, complex full-mouth reconstructions, and systematic preventive oral healthcare. Operating under a patient-centric administrative framework, Aesthetic Dental Designs, P.A. integrates cutting-edge dental technologies with rigorous clinical protocols. The enterprise maintains an established track record of therapeutic excellence, operational integrity, and superior patient outcomes within the South Florida healthcare market.
